verdicts.reason: A: the photo is a narrow strip down the middle, and a white text panel cuts a hard rectangle into its lower right, so the quote and the image collide awkwardly. The cloud shape is white on a white background, so it is invisible and only stray outlines show; the left third is dead, and the cross glyphs sit on the hands. B: the photo is cropped to a small square that loses most of the hands, and a cross glyph floats loose outside the photo. The cloud is again invisible white on white, and the left side is empty. Still, the quote and author sit cleanly on white with no collision, so B is the less broken of the two.
